modes.snakemake: Snakemake 9.23.1, --rerun-triggers mtime params; evict forced = explicit target 'all <job>', native = target 'all' (dry run)
modes.dvc: DVC 3.67.1, dvc repro --no-run-cache; evict forced = output file and cache object deleted ('cache object lost'), native = only the file deleted (restored from cache). run-cache off is conservative: can only add executions, never misses
modes.dagster: Dagster 1.13.26, stale-based materialization (stale_assets_only / data_version_changed: STALE|MISSING to a fixed point); evict forced = manual rematerialization, native = deleted file not noticed (status FRESH)
modes.dagster_eager: AutomationCondition.eager(): any_deps_updated on any new parent materialization, no cutoff; simulator only
modes.hyppo_safe: the complex: Algorithm-1 graph of baseline_filecache.hyppo_side, Manager(plan_mode='safe'), chained keys; store revision visible regardless of declaration
modes.nextflow_deep: cache='deep' (content hash, early cutoff); simulator only

meta.snakemake_triggers: real runs use --rerun-triggers mtime params; the default (all triggers) gives the same job sets for these events, checked by dry runs in the final state (real.<grid>.snakemake_triggers_check)
meta.gold: full recompute from scratch for every world state; wrong = output digest (rounded 1e-9) differs from gold; simulator deltas = exact sha256 changes of the gold outputs
meta.order: events applied sequentially with persistent state in both real runs and run_sequence

corpus_meta.generator: Генератор (детерминирован по seed и имени графа): сущности: m = ceil(|V|/4), у каждой 1..3 потребителя (равномерно, без повторов); пары (сущность, потребитель) перемешаны, объявлены первые round(p*|пар|) (вложенные множества по p); события: тип param:evict:revise = 6:3:1, param -- равномерный узел, выход меняется с вероятностью 0.7 (тогда меняются узел и все потомки, иначе ничего); evict -- равномерный узел (мир не меняется); revise -- равномерная сущность (меняются все потребители и их потомки).
corpus_meta.state: events per graph applied in order with persistent state (simulators.run_sequence)
corpus_meta.missed: newly wrong results kept after the event (W' minus W), summed over events
corpus_meta.native_evict: evaluated per evict event; state continues from the forced variant (as in the real runs, where each native step is followed by the forced one)

favourable_worlds.note: events where an early-cutoff system executes strictly fewer jobs than hyppo_safe: fewer_safe -- and no wrong result after the event (output unchanged: favourable world), fewer_with_miss -- with wrong results kept (undeclared revisions, now or earlier); more -- the cutoff system executes more (repairs results it missed earlier). Consistent with theorem 2 (minimax: hyppo_safe is minimal over all worlds consistent with the observations, not in each world)
